parts.text:
Analyze this emergency report and return ONLY a valid JSON object. Do not include markdown blocks around it, just raw JSON. Extract the following fields:
- type (must be one of: Fire, Medical, Earthquake, Flood, Accident, Crime, Hazmat, Other)
- severity (integer 1 to 10)
- peopleAffected (integer)
- gridRow (integer 0 to 9 representing location)
- gridCol (integer 0 to 9 representing location)
- locationName (short string)
- traffic (string e.g. HIGH/LOW/CLEAR)
- urgency (string e.g. CRITICAL/HIGH/MODERATE/LOW)
- summary (short string description)

Report: There is a major fire near Block C. Five people are trapped inside and traffic is heavy.
